documents_expected.why: call page: amounts, deadlines, match and what is not funded
FY2027 application form (Word): attachments, budget table, final report and invoice duties

eligibility.quote: The CHNEP provides Conservation Grants (up to $9,999) to community organizations for projects that address clean water, wildlife habitat protection and restoration, and outreach priorities in the CHNEP area

eligibility.rule: The project must be in the CHNEP 10-county region
eligibility.quote: To check to see if your project is in the CHNEP 10-county region: See Map

eligibility.rule: No restoration or improvements on private property, including HOAs
eligibility.quote: Restoration or improvements on private property (including in HOAs)
alt_quotes: Restoration or improvements on private property;

eligibility.rule: No projects or phases completed before the award
eligibility.quote: Projects/phase of project completed prior to the award of the grant;

eligibility.rule: No capital improvement, endowment or usual operating costs
eligibility.quote: Capital improvement or endowment funds, or usual operating costs;

eligibility.rule: Paid by reimbursement against deliverables; nothing is fronted
eligibility.quote: All funding is reimbursement based; no funding will be fronted for the project.
alt_quotes: Conservation grants are in the $500 to $9,999 range and are reimbursement-based.

eligibility.rule: The project must finish, with deliverables and invoice in, by 1 September 2027
eligibility.quote: FY27 awarded projects should conclude before September 1, 2027 with all deliverables and an invoice turned in by close of business that day.

documents.quote: Please complete all fields for the application to be evaluated for funding.
The budget justification is used to support monetary value of activities and deliverables produced.

documents.item: One-page resume for the project lead or organisation
documents.quote: A one-page resume for the project lead or organization.

effort.step: Email the application to Grants@chnep.org (winter cycle)
effort.quote: Winter Deadline is December 1, 2026 for a January 2027 award notice

effort.step: Or apply in the spring cycle
effort.quote: Spring Deadline is April 1, 2027 for a May 2027 award notice

effort.step: Submit the final report and invoice on letterhead
effort.quote: I will be asked to agree to complete the project and submit the Final Deliverable(s)/Report and Invoice on my organization letterhead (see example attached) requesting reimbursement by September 1, 2027.

co_finance_required.quote: Match is not required, but proposals showing matching fund commitment through in-kind services (such as volunteer hours), or direct funding from other sources will receive special consideration.

after_award.quote: A Final Report will be the deliverable for the project and is required for lump-sum based reimbursement.

notes: The call page says applications are due 'before December 1, 2026'; the form says the winter deadline is December 1 at 5:00 pm. Grants are $500 to $9,999. Match only earns special consideration. Awardees must also credit CHNEP and its logo on signage and media.
